name: Sidestep
tagline: A no-trump trick game where the suit you must follow can change mid-trick.
core_loop: Follow the current target suit if you can; if you are void, throw any card and a higher one steals the trick and makes its suit the new target suit for the players after you.
win_condition: Highest score from card values captured in tricks (Crown rank 3, Ace 2, K/Q/J 1) plus +1 for each trick won with a sidestep card.
